english.title: Possess article with blade / sharply pointed article on school premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without good reason or lawful authority, had with you on school premises, namely **(..SPECIFY SCHOOL PREMISES..),

(A)_[an article which had a blade or was sharply pointed, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..)]_
(B)_[a folding pocket knife which had a blade the cutting edge of which exceeded 7.62 centimetres or three inches]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 139A(1) and (5) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without good reason/lawful authority
have with you on school premises an article
with a blade/sharply pointed article OR
folding pocket knife with blade cutting edge exceeding 7.62cm (3 inches)

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Option A: 'article with a blade' will include a lock knife.
(ii) Section 42 of the Violent Crime Reduction Act 2006 increased the penalty on indictment four years imprisonment. For offences committed before 12th February 2007 see H4430.
(iii) The Offensive Weapons Act 2019 extended this offence to further education premises, for offences committed on or after 6th April 2022 see H20298.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Four years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
